title: Bond Traders Bite at Microsoft-Tied Data Center Junk-Like Yields
summary: Blackstone Inc.-backed QTS Realty Trust Inc. offered junk-like yields on a $3.9 billion high-grade bond to fund the construction of a Microsoft Corp.-linked data center in Georgia. It looks to have worked as the deal racked up demand of about six times that amount.

title: Ex-Tricolor Executives Face SEC Lawsuit After Firm Collapse
summary: Tricolor Holdings founder Daniel Chu, who already faces federal charges, and two other former executives were sued by the US Securities and Exchange Commission for allegedly defrauding investors before the used car seller and subprime lender imploded.

title: Trump Will Have to Make 'Bad Deal' With Iran, Says Former National Security Advisor Jake Sullivan
summary:
Jake Sullivan, former US national security advisor in the Biden administration, said that at some point Trump is going to have to 'bite the bullet and do a bad deal' with Iran as the country ramps up its leverage in negotiations with the United States. Sullivan also discussed Israel Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's role in the conflict, saying that Netanyahu had come to past administrations to attempt to convince past presidents to take action against Iran. 
 (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Pending Home Sales Drop to Weakest Since Start of Year
summary: Pending sales of previously owned US homes dropped in July to the weakest since the start of the year. Bloomberg Intelligence's Drew Reading has more. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Trump Overhaul Prompts Dulles Board to Seek $14 Billion in Bonds
summary: The governing board that oversees Washington Dulles International Airport will vote Wednesday on whether to add $15.5 billion to its capital budget to finance the airport’s multi-year overhaul backed by President Donald Trump.

title: Boeing-Lockheed Space Venture Inks $1.5 Billion Private Bonds
summary: Boeing Co. and Lockheed Martin Corp.’s rocket joint venture is wrapping up a $1.5 billion private-bond deal that’s been tripled in size.

title: Five Grain Ships Struck Near Russian Black Sea Ports
summary: At least five grain ships have been attacked near the Russian Black Sea ports of Novorossiysk and Tuapse as Moscow struggles to continue exporting grain amid heightened Ukrainian strikes, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: Chip Rout Pulls Stocks Down as Bond Angst Lingers: Markets Wrap
summary: A slump in chipmakers sent stocks lower, with the market also falling as anxiety about inflation and rising government debt kept bond yields elevated.

title: Historic Copper Squeeze Eases as Traders Deliver Metal to LME
summary: One of the largest ever squeezes in the copper market eased somewhat on Tuesday after traders including Trafigura Group made significant deliveries of metal to the London Metal Exchange.

title: US Stocks Drop, Led by Tech, as Bond-Yield Spike Sparks Angst
summary: US stocks fell on Tuesday, led by a slump in technology shares, as elevated bond yields and gains in oil prices prompted investors to pare back some of their riskier trades including bets on AI.

title: Guggenheim 77% Earnings Hit Stems From Unit Whistleblower Tagged
summary: A steep decline in Guggenheim Investments’ second-quarter earnings was driven by a delay in reporting certain fee revenue from its private investments unit, where accounting was the subject of a whistleblower report that helped spark a wider probe into Mark Walter’s empire.

title: Walter Probe Weighs on Carvana as Investors Suspect Share Sale
summary: Shares of online used-car dealer Carvana Co. are extending losses Tuesday, hurt by concerns that one of the company’s largest investors — billionaire Mark Walter — may sell down his stake as he contends with a federal probe of his investment empire.

title: University of California System Offloads $1 Billion of Private Equity Stakes
summary: The University of California system sold $1 billion of private equity stakes to HarbourVest Partners, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: Gold Falls as Traders Weigh US Inflation, Rates Amid Bond Rout
summary: Gold declined as traders weighed the outlook for US inflation and interest rates amid a global government bond rout.

title: EM Rally Hits a Wall as Global Yields Climb, Oil Prices Rally
summary: Emerging markets lost momentum on Tuesday as a surge in long-term US Treasury yields collided with renewed tensions in the Middle East, ending a four-day winning streak for stocks and driving borrowing costs higher across developing economies.

title: BP Joins Venezuelan Oil Trade to Challenge Trafigura and Vitol
summary: BP Plc has become the latest foreign company to begin trading Venezuelan oil since the US removed former President Nicolás Maduro, following in the footsteps of Trafigura Group and Vitol Group.

title: Starwood Team Lends $672 Million for US Outdoor Storage Lots
summary: Starwood Property Trust Inc. and Realterm, a global investment manager focused on transportation, provided a $672 million loan for a group of US industrial outdoor storage lots.
